details.title: National Bank updates foreign exchange reporting requirements
details.shortDescription: The National Bank of Kazakhstan (NBK) has introduced new reporting obligations for resident and non-resident entities on cross-border foreign exchange transactions.
details.overviewLead: On June 24, 2026, the National Bank of Kazakhstan issued Regulation No. 24/2026, amending Regulation No. 8/2019 on the execution of foreign exchange transactions and their accounting and reporting. The amendments aim to enhance transparency of cross-border FX flows, align with international standards, and strengthen the country's external sector statistics.
details.overviewBody: The regulation expands the scope of reportable transactions, shortens reporting deadlines, and introduces new templates for data submission through the banks' reporting system.
details.appliesTo: Authorized banks, residents, non-residents conducting cross-border FX transactions

keyChanges.title: Expanded Reporting Scope
keyChanges.description: New requirements apply to a broader range of cross-border transactions including digital services, IP payments, and intra-group transfers.

keyChanges.title: Shorter Reporting Deadlines
keyChanges.description: Transaction reports must be submitted within 2 business days instead of 5 business days from the date of transaction.

keyChanges.title: New Reporting Templates
keyChanges.description: Revised forms for statistical reporting on cross-border FX transactions introduced in accordance with BPM6 standards.

keyChanges.title: Additional Data Fields
keyChanges.description: Reports must include additional details on counterparty country, purpose code, and underlying economic activity.

keyChanges.title: Strengthened Compliance
keyChanges.description: NBK to conduct more frequent data reconciliation and apply risk-based supervision on reporting accuracy.

keyChanges.title: Penalties
keyChanges.description: Administrative penalties for late, incomplete, or inaccurate reporting have been increased.

impactAnalysis.title: Banks
impactAnalysis.description: Banks will need to update internal systems and processes to capture additional data points and meet shorter reporting timelines.

impactAnalysis.title: Businesses
impactAnalysis.description: Companies engaged in cross-border transactions should ensure accurate classification and timely submission.

impactAnalysis.title: Market
impactAnalysis.description: Improved data quality will enhance monitoring of capital flows and external sector stability assessment.

timelineItems.description: Transition period for system updates and adaptation
